purpose: bear, base and bull drivers for a ten-year discounted-cash-flow model

basis.revenue_base: trailing four quarters of revenue in the calculator ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}); year-one growth is measured from that base
basis.margin_basis: GAAP operating income as the calculator's ebit basis ({ebit}), after amortization of acquired intangibles, restructuring and impairments; adjusted operating profit in the release is higher and is used only to reason about direction
basis.reinvestment_basis: net reinvestment (capital expenditure plus acquisitions plus working-capital change less depreciation and amortization) as a share of after-tax operating income; the calculator's trailing depreciation and amortization ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}) exceeds capital expenditure ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}) because most of it is intangible amortization, so the rates below are set on economic reinvestment rather than the accounting difference
basis.tax_rate_caution: the calculator's trailing tax rate ({tax_rate}) reflects a one-time valuation-allowance release; a model should use a normal rate near the adjusted rate shown in the release, not the calculator field
basis.discount_rate_note: cost of equity is available ({cost_of_capital.cost_of_equity}) but WACC is missing ({cost_of_capital.wacc}) because interest expense is not tagged; the filing's weighted-average coupon on long-term notes and the commercial-paper rate are the natural inputs for cost of debt

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: Divestitures of Riello and Noresco remove roughly two points of revenue, residential and light-commercial recovery stalls, China stays weak and truck-and-trailer remains in a trough, so organic growth only just offsets the exits; the trailing base is already slightly below the year-earlier four quarters.
revenue_growth_year_one.quote: ~$225 million and ~$125 million year-over-year revenue headwind from Riello and NORESCO exits, respectively

terminal_growth.reason: A mature climate-equipment franchise growing with replacement demand and modest price, held well below the risk-free rate because the bear case assumes tariff-driven cost inflation is not fully passed through and China does not recover.
terminal_growth.quote: Results in China decreased (down 14%) as end-markets experienced economic challenges impacting both demand and price.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Set near the trailing GAAP margin with a small recovery as the Riello impairment does not repeat, but with restructuring continuing, tariffs and mix still compressing gross margin and joint-venture income lower; below the prior fiscal year's GAAP margin.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: Gross margin decreased by $41 million compared with the three months ended June 30, 2025, primarily due to higher input costs, including the impact of tariffs, and unfavorable business mix.

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: Only modest improvement over the decade: intangible amortization keeps running, price-cost stays roughly neutral, antitrust and tariff overhangs cap pricing, and mix does not shift enough toward higher-margin data-center and aftermarket work.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: Adjusted operating margin of 17.2% was down 190 basis points from last year, predominantly due to favorable volume and productivity more than offset by the impact of increased input costs and unfavorable business mix.

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: The new United States factory and rising capital expenditure fall on a smaller after-tax operating profit, and a seasonal working-capital build is not fully released, so reinvestment takes a larger share of a weaker profit base.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: Includes ~($0.05) adj. EPS impact from NORESCO exit and new U.S. factory costs

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: Terminal reinvestment consistent with the bear growth rate and a return on capital only modestly above the cost of capital, given the low asset turnover of a goodwill-heavy balance sheet.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: The primary driver of the outflow related to $211 million of capital expenditures.

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: Raised full-year guidance implies mid-single-digit growth over the trailing base once the divestiture headwind is netted against mid-to-high-single-digit organic growth and a small currency tailwind; the quarter already returned to organic growth with residential and light commercial leading.
revenue_growth_year_one.quote: Given record backlog levels and our year-to-date performance, we are raising our full-year outlook and now expect sales of about $23 billion and adjusted EPS of ~$2.90.

terminal_growth.reason: Below the risk-free rate as required, reflecting long-run replacement demand, electrification and data-center cooling as structural supports for a global leader, tempered by cyclicality and a mature core.
terminal_growth.quote: Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Adjusted operating profit guidance on the guided sales level, less intangible amortization at roughly the current run rate and a normal restructuring charge, lands near the three-year average GAAP margin and above the prior fiscal year, with no repeat of the Riello impairment.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: Raises full year outlook to ~$23B sales, ~$3.5B adj. op. profit and ~$2.90 adj. EPS

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: Gradual expansion as the lower-margin Riello and Noresco businesses leave the mix, data-center and aftermarket service grow faster than the core, restructuring savings arrive, and the amortization of acquired intangibles declines as customer-relationship assets age.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: Total company orders1 up ~40%; Commercial HVAC1 up ~65%; data centers up >300%

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: Capital expenditure is stepping up for the new factory and working capital grows with sales, but intangible amortization far exceeds capital spending and small tuck-in acquisitions are the norm, so net economic reinvestment is a moderate share of after-tax operating profit.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, net cash used in continuing investing activities was $235 million. The primary driver of the outflow related to $211 million of capital expenditures.

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: Terminal reinvestment equal to terminal growth divided by a return on capital in the low double digits, consistent with an asset turnover that stays low because goodwill and intangibles remain most of the asset base.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: Free cash flow is a non-GAAP financial measure that represents net cash flows provided by continuing operating activities (a GAAP measure) less capital expenditures.

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: Record backlog converts faster than guided, data-center and container demand stay strong, residential and light commercial keep recovering with price, and the currency tailwind persists, so growth exceeds the guidance midpoint even after the divestiture headwind.
revenue_growth_year_one.quote: Orders were very strong globally in the second quarter supported by continued data center demand.

terminal_growth.reason: Still below the risk-free rate, but reflecting structural demand from electrification, heat pumps and data-center cooling sustaining above-inflation growth for a category leader.
terminal_growth.quote: The Company expects a majority of its current contract liabilities at the end of the period to be recognized as revenue in the next 12 months.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Price-cost turns favorable as tariff costs are recovered through price, restructuring charges fall away after the front-loaded first half, the impairment does not repeat, and volume leverage on productivity lifts GAAP margin above the prior fiscal year and the three-year average.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: CSA segment sales grew 4%. Organic sales were up 4% driven by Residential and Light Commercial (RLC), up 9% and 10% respectively, partially offset by Commercial1, down 8% due to the timing of customer deliveries.

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: Mix shifts decisively toward data-center, commercial and aftermarket service, divested low-margin businesses are gone, intangible amortization tapers, and the margin approaches the fiscal year in the history with the strongest GAAP margin after the spin-off.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: Raises full year outlook to ~$23B sales, ~$3.5B adj. op. profit and ~$2.90 adj. EPS

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: Capacity additions are already under way and working capital is released as joint-venture receivables normalize, so a higher profit base carries the factory spend at a somewhat lower rate than the base case.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: Net cash flows generated from operating activities were $927 million and capital expenditures were $117 million, resulting in free cash flow of $810 million.

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: Higher terminal growth requires slightly more reinvestment than the base case even with a better return on capital; the rate is terminal growth over a low-teens return on capital.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: Free cash flow is a non-GAAP financial measure that represents net cash flows provided by continuing operating activities (a GAAP measure) less capital expenditures.

limits: Margins are set on the calculator's GAAP operating-income basis; a model built on adjusted operating profit would need to add back intangible amortization and restructuring explicitly and treat them as ongoing cash-free and cash charges respectively.
The calculator's tax rate is not usable for after-tax operating profit; the release's adjusted rate is the better anchor and the model should apply its own normal rate.
WACC is missing because interest expense is not tagged; the weighted-average coupon on long-term notes and the commercial-paper rate in the filing are the inputs a model should use for cost of debt.
Year-one growth is measured from the trailing four quarters, which include Riello and Noresco revenue that will leave the base; the scenarios net the headwind rather than restate the base.
Reinvestment rates describe economic reinvestment, not the accounting gap between capital expenditure and depreciation and amortization, which is negative because of intangible amortization.

No scenario includes cash for the AFFF settlement or a loss on the antitrust class actions, and none includes tariff refunds or insurance recoveries; all four are outside the operating drivers and should be handled as separate equity adjustments.
